decisive_rule: the handle must resolve to a named dataset with an open licence text and a per-row table/figure locator before any row may be exported; failing that the verdict is not_verifiable and the ceiling is Tier C
tier_rule: a gas-phase computed epsilon is a different quantity from a liquid-phase experimental epsilon (missing orientational correlation g), so the set may only ever enter as Tier C

physics_reason.statement: a gas-phase computed epsilon and a liquid-phase experimental epsilon are different quantities
physics_reason.why_g_is_one_in_gas: a single-molecule DFPT calculation has no orientational correlation, so g = 1 by construction
physics_reason.consequence: the set may only ever enter as Tier C, never as a label for the liquid-phase experimental target
